headline: Kuwait Fund wants to build a seven-story hospital in Naryn
summary: Representatives of the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development visited Kyrgyzstan on a two-day working trip. Discussions included a proposed seven-storey hospital in Naryn.
why: The Kuwait Fund is a development lender that finances infrastructure and social projects in developing countries, often through loans and grants.
original_headline: Кувейтский фонд хочет построить в Нарыне семиэтажную больницу
